labels.label: defi:BTZtop
checks: Statement fidelity: the definition exists for every lightlike line (indeed every subset Δ, the lightlike case being where its explicit form is proved), with J⁺(Δ) = lean-causal's (Causal.minkowski 2).Jplus ⊤ Δ and I⁺(p) = Iplus ⊤ {p}; no notion redefined.

'generated by' rendered correctly: induced ⊓ generateFrom (btzLineGen Δ) is the topology whose opens are generated by the induced opens together with the traces of I⁺(p) ∪ ]p,+∞[, p ∈ Δ; btzLineTop_le_iff states the universal property and is proved.

'relatively open future half-ray from p' is intrinsically Δ ∩ J⁺(p) ∖ {p}, proved equal to {p + σw : σ > 0} with w the future null direction (w.1 > 0, minkQ w = 0) — checked the proof: from J⁺ one gets (s' − s) w.1 ≥ 0 hence s ≤ s', and q ≠ p gives s < s'; converse via minkQ(σw) = 0 and σw.1 > 0.

Generators lie in J⁺(Δ) (btzLineGenSet_subset) and are open (isOpen_btzLine_gen); not trivialised (the finer-than-induced property and the generator property are genuine, and btzJTop_eq_coinduced shows on the model line it is exactly the image of T_BTZ, the paper's motivation l.2279).
REPORT hypotheses ('carried' for Δ lightlike and for 'generated by') now accurate.

labels.label: prop:quotient_chart
checks: btz_quotient_chart: for every x₀, every v with v.2.1 > 0 (⟨v|u⟩ < 0), every α ≠ 0 and every singular structure on BTZModel α satisfying IsBTZStructure x₀ v α (satisfiable: Model's exists_isBTZStructure, and the paper's instance is btzE0_quotient_chart with α = 2π, x₀ = 0, v = btzV0), D̄ = btzQuotDevHomeomorph is a homeomorphism 𝔼₀ ≃ₜ Γ\J⁺(Δ), pinned to the map induced by D (first conjunct, rfl), and D̄ and D̄⁻¹ are IsAEMorphism — the paper's 'isomorphism of singular E^{1,2}-manifolds' (rem:composition_morphisms_morphisms_category); also packaged in SingGXCat (btzQuotChartIso).

J⁺(Δ) carries btzJTop = btzLineTop (btzLine x₀), i.e. defi:BTZtop for the paper's Δ; the topology of BTZModel α is the paper's quotient topology (btz_coinduced_hornTop from coinduced_orbitMk_tamTop); Γ\J⁺(Δ) carries the quotient topology of btzJTop for the holonomy action btzJAction (D equivariant, btzJDev_smul).

The homeomorphism is genuinely proved: continuity of D from T_BTZ because D⁻¹(I⁺(p_s) ∪ ]p_s,+∞[) = {s < t + κr} (btzDevM_mem_genSet_iff), openness at the axis from btz_axis_diamond, off the axis from the local homeomorphism isLocalHomeomorphOn_btzDevM; descends to orbits on both sides.

The structure on Γ\J⁺(Δ) is not transported along D̄ (which would trivialise the a.e.-morphism claim): it is the quotient (existsUnique_aeGXQuotient, built from proved freeness btzJ_free, discontinuity btzJ_disc, Γ acting by a.e. morphisms btzJ_isAEMorphism_smul) of the structure of J⁺(Δ) whose charts are the identity of 𝐌³ on J⁺(Δ) ∖ Δ. Checked this is a legitimate (G,X)-structure: for a lightlike line J⁺(Δ) = I⁺(Δ) ∪ Δ (a point of the null plane u^⊥ off Δ is spacelike to every point of Δ), so J⁺(Δ) ∖ Δ is the open half-space, open in 𝐌³, consistent with isLocalHomeomorphOn_btzJ_val.
No hidden assumption carries the conclusion; no extra hypothesis (the generalisation in x₀, v, α is a strengthening, reported as such).

issues.problem: The row is 'closed' and marked while its 'questions' slot (the slot CAMPAIGN.md reserves for 'a definition the paper leaves open, and the reading you took') holds an open question about which singular structure Γ\J⁺(Δ) carries. Read literally, the protocol makes a reading-dependent row partial. On the merits the choice is forced rather than a reading — the regular part Γ\(J⁺(Δ)∖Δ) is a quotient of an open subset of 𝐌³ by a free, properly discontinuous group of isometries, and the singular structure extending it is unique (btzJQuot_existsUnique) — so the mark is not an overclaim; only the bookkeeping is inconsistent.
issues.fix: Move the sentence from 'questions' to 'findings' (or the hypothesis row 'carried', as already done), stating that the structure is the canonical one and unique, so the row is not reading-dependent; or keep it a question and record that the closure is subject to the author's confirmation.
